rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold the 6-Justice coalition together with a narrow, text-focused reading of EMTALA’s “direct conflict” clause and a limited (or vacated) injunction, while leaving room for as-applied relief in truly irreconcilable cases. Separate writings are likely because Thomas/Alito will press clear-statement/federalism limits, and the three dissenters will emphasize Galen and impossibility in health-threatening (not just death-threatening) emergencies.
